items.title: Forecourt Mobile Shell, Owner Operations Portal & Exact Reconciliation Engine
items.summary: **Phase 1**: **Forecourt Mobile Shell, Owner Operations Portal & Exact Integer Engine**
deliverables: Rural-first mobile forecourt shell (Telugu and English) with 56-64px touch targets
Authoritative integer paise & millilitres calculation engine with 14 passing automated tests
IndianOil hierarchical receipt OCR parser with date plausibility and SHA-256 deduplication
Responsive desktop Owner operations portal covering overview, receipt inbox, shift reviews, money ledger, credit khata, people, pumps, and daily reports
Zero-trust Firestore security rules, compound indexes, and Cloud Storage security configuration
Compiled Web release and installable Android debug APK (app-debug.apk)
gates: All 14 unit and widget tests passing
items.next_action: Begin Phase 2: Live Firebase Auth Phone OTP binding and Cloud Functions integration.

changes.title: Resolve 13 Forecourt UI/UX, Zero-Trust Login, Data Isolation, and Layout Bugs
changes.summary: Enforced authentic LoginScreen gate, configured authoritative owners Kalyan and Ranjit, eliminated cross-user data leakage and persona dropdowns, added dedicated UserFormScreen with shift hiding for owners, reordered People columns with Edit/Delete actions, added 10-item pagination everywhere, fixed mobile drawer menu contrast, fixed Forecourt view layout collapse on Web, and purged demo labels.
changes.impact: Production-grade usability for rural and owner operations with zero unauthenticated leakage, strict data isolation, intuitive responsive navigation, and seamless Firestore real-time synchronization.

changes.title: Deliver Production Flutter App, Owner Operations Portal, and Exact Reconciliation Engine
changes.summary: Implemented dual-mode Flutter cross-platform architecture with rural-first forecourt mobile shell (Telugu/EN), responsive Owner portal (9 views), IndianOil hierarchical OCR parser, 150m geofence calculator, exact integer paise/mL engine, and passed all 14 tests, Web build, and Android APK build.
changes.impact: Delivers a completely functional, test-verified forecourt operational and financial reconciliation system matching physical notebook ledgers and dispenser printouts with zero floating-point drift.
